note: Normative conformance vectors. An implementation conforms only if it reproduces every canonical form and hash, verifies every must_accept receipt, and rejects every must_reject case.

canonicalisation.note: array order is preserved, not sorted
a signature field is excluded from its own preimage

tree_heads.note: A conforming verifier evaluates a tree head against a witness policy: it counts only endorsements from pinned keys, never counts the log's own key, and requires the head to commit to the same root the inclusion proofs were checked against. An implementation that accepts any must_reject case will accept an unwitnessed log, which is the one failure this format exists to prevent.

must_accept.case: quorum met by pinned independent witnesses
must_accept.why: two endorsements from keys the relying party pinned, neither of them the log's own

must_accept.case: quorum of one, with a second unpinned endorsement present
must_accept.why: an extra signature from an unpinned key is ignored, not counted and not fatal

must_reject.why: THE DEFINING ASSERTION. A correctly signed root with no independent cosignature must be rejected, however impeccable the receipts under it.
the log endorsing its own head is not a witness; no party witnesses itself
one key signing twice is one witness, not a quorum of two
endorsements gathered for an earlier root must not transfer to a new one
a valid signature from a key nobody pinned is discarded, not counted
a head signed over a different tree than the inclusion proofs were checked against proves nothing about those receipts
a cosignature that does not verify under its own witness_id is not an endorsement
